== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Kir Kanos (V)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column.
